paragraphs.core_text: When he built and constructed the worlds, he suspended the zones on their zones, and within another zone also. The first zone is the five powers of darkness, males and females.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic cosmological architecture: zones suspended on zones. Both sides of the mapping are cosmic — zones mapped to zones, first zone identified as the five powers of Darkness with male and female aspects. Impersonal process-oriented voice. The 'he' (Living Spirit) acts as cosmic agent within the system.

paragraphs.core_text: This is why he hung one zone on a zone! He hung the five powers of darkness on the five shining men, the sons of the Man; because all the enmity is entwined and bound in them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Explains the zone-suspension rationale: Darkness hung on the five sons of the First Man. Both sides of the mapping stay within the cosmic system — cosmic powers mapped to cosmic powers. 'All the enmity is entwined and bound in them' is a binding formula describing cosmic process. High substrate score (35.14).

paragraphs.core_text: Also, within the zone are the five sons of the [Living] Spirit; because the entire edifice is suspended from them, it being [ ... ... he]ard (?) him too, the oth[ers ... ... ] after them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third zone: the five sons of the Living Spirit who bear the entire cosmic edifice. Heavy lacunae in the second half but readable content is entirely cosmic architecture — the structural hierarchy of the universe. 'Entire edifice suspended from them' is the key cosmological statement.

paragraphs.core_text: And this is the one who came to [ ... ... the fi]rmaments above [ ... ] which is in one zone, is the great [King of Honour] who e[xists ... ] within the [ ... ... ] of the universe.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Identifies the King of Honour in the firmaments as the key structural agent. Heavy lacunae obscure much of the content, but what survives maps cosmic beings to cosmic geography (King of Honour → firmaments → universe). Both sides stay within the cosmic system.
